text:
noah: Repro on 320px: footer CTA overlaps last table row when sidebar is overlayed. Screenshot: https://img.redwood.dev/ux/footer-overlap-320.png
ellen: Which CTA? The sticky "Create deployment"?
noah: Yep. When sidebar slides in header flashes and footer overlaps dense rows. Seems like stacking / overflow change on body causes it.
pat: That matches previous bugs. Sliding transform + body overflow toggles break sticky positioning. Try avoid changing body overflow; use fixed positioned overlay instead.
jin: Also reduced-motion helps but doesn't solve overlap. Likely stacking context caused by `transform` on ancestor. Quick CSS idea: make footer `position: fixed; z-index: 9000` and ensure it doesn't trap focus.
elllen: (typo) ellen: Fixed footer raises SR concerns. If we do fixed, add aria-hidden when dismissed and ensure keyboard order still reaches primary action.
pat: Add `contain: layout` to table wrapper to limit reflow, but only on virtualized viewport to avoid perf hit on low-end Android.
noah: UX question: should overlay push content or slide over? Slide over is more discoverable but causes these conflicts.
elllen: Slide over preferred. So we must implement overlay without toggling body `overflow` or changing root positioning. Use inert overlay + `touch-action` lock.
jin: Also note CTA label truncation. On tiny widths use icon+aria-label or shorter label. I'd A/B test "New deployment" vs icon-only.
noah: I'll prototype:
```css
.app-footer { position: fixed; left:0; right:0; bottom:0; z-index:9000; }
.table-wrapper { contain: layout; }
.sidebar-overlay { position: fixed; right: 0; transform: translateX(100%); will-change: transform; }
```
pat: QA list: iPhone 8 Safari, Pixel 3a Chrome, Android webview, VoiceOver, TalkBack, large text.
ux-bot: Issue created https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/issues/2937 assigned to @ellen @pat.
noah: I'll open a canary PR behind `mobile_footer_fix` and add telemetry `ui.footer.create_variant`. Tagging when ready for accessibility pass. :sparkles:
